Channeling Atlas discovery expansion — 2026-10-23

All-links, type-specific and per-practitioner CSV tables contain link metadata, provenance, unknown dates and attribution limits. Person entries are not a unique-human or annual-active census. Account aliases are merged only when explicitly linked. by-channeler/ includes one CSV per practitioner/lineage/partial-name entry; unattributed-links.csv preserves unresolved narrators and distributors. See research-summary.json and search-log.csv for executed coverage.

Repository seed: occult-kranti/bashar-index, commit 457dc2f2da10399bda2786573b7a77ec3fe34f62. Repository-derived metadata is reused under its MIT license (included). No transcripts or recordings are reproduced.
